links.outcome: Adenoma detection rate with versus without AI-assisted colonoscopy in real-world practice
links.effect: ADR 45.1% vs 38.8% (p=0.010); SSLDR 5.7% vs 2.5% (p=0.001); APC 0.78 vs 0.61 (IRR 1.27, 95% CI 1.13-1.42). Non-randomized prospective comparison.
links.quote: The ENAD group had a significantly higher ADR (45.1% vs. 38.8%, p=0.010), higher sessile serrated lesion detection rate (SSLDR) (5.7% vs. 2.5%, p=0.001), higher mean number of adenomas per colonoscopy (APC) (0.78±1.17 vs. 0.61±0.99; incidence risk ratio, 1.27; 95% confidence interval, 1.13-1.42), and longer withdrawal time (9.0±3.4 vs. 8.3±3.1, p<0.001) than the SC group.

screen.reason: Prospective real-world clinical study evaluating the diagnostic performance (adenoma detection rate) of a computer-aided detection (CADe) tool during live colonoscopy, comparing AI-assisted vs standard colonoscopy.
